planned_title: What Will the Night Sky Look Like When Gliese 710 Arrives?
spoken: Gliese 710 is the brightest star in the whole night sky, about three times brighter than Sirius and as bright as Jupiter at its best, and it glows orange. Most stars look fixed for a lifetime. This one will creep across the sky by about the width of the full moon every 35 years.
